title: FPGA Technology Mapping Using Sketch-Guided Program Synthesis
problem: FPGA technology mapping requires mapping HDL designs to architecture-specific primitives like DSPs, currently done via error-prone handwritten rules that miss mapping opportunities. Heterogeneous modern FPGAs need better, more extensible synthesis tools.
motivation: As FPGAs become increasingly heterogeneous with complex configurable primitives, automated technology mapping tools are essential for achieving higher performance and broader mapping coverage.
method: Lakeroad uses sketch-guided program synthesis to automate FPGA technology mapping by employing architecture-independent sketch templates to capture mapping patterns and extracting semantics from HDL to discover valid mappings, systematically replacing handwritten rules.
key_novelty: Architecture-independent sketch templates combined with sketch-guided program synthesis for automated FPGA technology mapping with correctness guarantees.
contributions: Lakeroad framework demonstrating sketch-guided program synthesis for automated technology mapping
Architecture-independent sketch templates generalizing across DSP implementations
HDL semantics extraction for comprehensive mapping discovery
Achieves 2-3.5x more optimal mappings than proprietary tools and 6-44x more than open-source tools

metrics.other: 2-3.5x more optimal mappings vs proprietary tools, 6-44x more vs open-source tools
